title: catalog.country v1 (CIS → AA-Booking, TripPlanner)
description: ISO 3166-1 countries as the CIS catalog read model exposes them (AA-851, CIS migration 279; data standards X5 / DM-2.4 / NAM-11). `countries` = rows of catalog.v_country over the CIS table shared.countries, the one country table of the ecosystem (249 entries, seeded from Debian iso-codes 4.16.0), key iso2. `name` is the common English short name AA writes in its catalog (Vietnam, South Korea, Laos, Taiwan), `iso_name` the ISO 3166-1 English short name (Viet Nam, Korea, Republic of). `destinations` = the country key of catalog.v_destination: CIS 279 appends `country_iso2` (NULL when the free-text country did not resolve; CIS lists those in its orphan report), so a consumer joins v_destination.country_iso2 = v_country.iso2 instead of matching names; that column is folded into the next catalog.tour minor. SELECT on catalog.v_country to `booking` and `tripplanner` (contracts rule 5). Reference data, read on demand or cached; no events. booking.countries stays Booking's own list of markets it sells, keyed by the same iso2. Columns may be appended (minor); removing or renaming one needs a v2 view (contracts README rule 2). No prices, no personal data.

name.description: Common English short name (the spelling AA uses).

destination_country.description: The country columns of one catalog.v_destination row (the other columns: catalog.tour).

country_iso2.description: Key into countries.iso2; NULL when the country text did not resolve.
